name: Cloudtype

evidence.paas: 03: managed container app platform; Cloudtype builds and runs the customer's services
evidence.static: 04: static HTML and SPA deployments are documented

line: Build and run containerized apps with managed deployments.

free.text: 1GB RAM, 4 services, 1 project, 1GB temp DB disk; 100GB outbound

work.math: ₩6,600 a month for the Hobby capacity subtotal. 100 GB is the paid traffic allowance. Request charges and the full commercial total are not confirmed.
A nominal 1 GB RAM + 1 vCPU is ₩19,800 a month. A conservative 1,536 MB RAM + 1 vCPU is ₩26,400. Whether it exactly fits 1 GiB is not confirmed.
Nominal app and database capacity subtotal is ₩46,200 a month (conservative ₩59,400). Automatic backups are not included and must be priced separately.
